description.value:
You project a mass effect field that hurls a creature or object with violent force.

Choose a creature or unattended object within 60 feet. The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|options:me-power:me-npc-biotic-throw] save against the creature's power DC.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success The target is pushed 5 feet away from you.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(2*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d8[bludgeoning]] damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. If pushed into a solid object, the target takes an additional 1d6 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone.

Critical Failure As failure, but 4d8 bludgeoning damage and pushed 20 feet. If pushed into an obstacle, additional 2d6 bludgeoning and knocked prone.

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
